segments.name: Technology solutions
products: SaaS-based integrated tools that manage patient access, registration and payment
segments.description: Provides software, payments and engagement solutions that improve operational and financial performance of healthcare organizations and patient health outcomes.
segments.evidence: Accordingly, the Company has determined that it operates in a single reportable operating segment, managed on a consolidated basis, which the Company refers to as the Technology solutions segment.

revenueModel.text: Healthcare organizations pay recurring subscription fees and payment processing and financing fees, while life sciences companies and other organizations pay per-engagement fees under annual contracts.
revenueModel.evidence: Our business model provides meaningful visibility into future revenue, as our revenue is primarily derived from recurring subscription fees and re-occurring payment processing fees and financing fees.

changes.text: In fiscal year 2026, Phreesia completed the acquisition of AccessOne, expanding its addressable market for healthcare payments.
changes.evidence: In fiscal year 2026, we completed the acquisition (the "AccessOne Acquisition") of AccessOne Parent Holdings, Inc. (together with its subsidiaries, "AccessOne"), which expands our addressable market for healthcare payments.

changes.text: In fiscal year 2026, the payment solutions revenue stream was renamed from payment processing fees to include financing fees as well.
changes.evidence: We generate revenue through a diversified model that includes three revenue streams: subscription and related services; payment solutions (previously labeled payment processing fees), which include payment processing fees and financing fees; and Network Solutions
